policy: Index direction comes from market data; causal drivers are stated only when collected sources explicitly connect them to the same-direction final move. Otherwise items are labeled context.

Canada.label: Canada
Canada.headline: TSX closes higher as technology stocks rebound, lifting the S&P/TSX Composite
Canada.why: No single verified causal driver for the final move was established in the collected sources; the items below are context rather than proven causes.

drivers.label: Tech sector recovery
drivers.detail: Celestica gained 2% after a global selloff, cited as the key lift for the TSX close (Investing.com, 2026-11-07).

drivers.label: Tech strength overall
drivers.detail: The broader tech strength was cited as the main reason for the TSX's rise (The Globe and Mail, 2026-11-06).

drivers.label: Earlier broad‑based selling
drivers.detail: An earlier report noted broad‑based selling that pushed the index sharply lower earlier in the session (kalkine.ca, 2026-11-06), but this did not determine the final positive close.

India.label: India
India.headline: Indian markets surge as oil prices fall, foreign inflows rise and bank earnings boost sentiment
India.why: The rally was driven by a sharp slide in crude oil prices, strong foreign fund inflows, robust earnings from banks and a rally in consumer‑durables stocks, all of which were highlighted by multiple news outlets as the immediate reasons for the gains.
